stages.description: Raw pixel-level Random Forest binary classification strictly within Thoothukudi district.
Morphological sieve filter removing isolated pixel clumps < 1,000 m2 within district.
Vector polygonization with strict Minimum Mapping Unit (MMU >= 1,000 m2) filter within district.

regional_full_scene.notes: Regional satellite inference included 627 polygons outside Thoothukudi district in adjacent districts (Ramanathapuram, Tirunelveli), which are excluded from the district inventory.

notes: Post-processing eliminates spatial noise and sub-resolution slivers. Strictly clipped to Thoothukudi district boundary.
